regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, graphical abstract, authors, dates, and SI link
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate photocatalytic 2,3-allenoic-acid/sulfonyl-chloride transformation. The page advertises online SI, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI-only fact was imported.
P1–P3 are structural examples of bioactive 4-sulfonylated furanones, not reaction experiments; no synthesis record was fabricated for them.
The oxidation route and two SO2-mediated routes are classified as prior-literature examples; the lower sulfonyl-chloride arrow is the generic current scheme. None is assigned a Table 1 row yield.
Four independent solvent trials (DCM, MeCN, THF, DMA) use 1a 0.1 mmol, 2a 1 equiv, 0.05 M, N2, room temperature, 16 h and give NR with 100/100/100/80% recovery of 1a.

unresolved: Prior-work schemes are generic and omit unique structures or complete procedures.
Scheme 2 does not state the recovery measurement basis or detection limits.

regions.region: page 2 lower-column optimization narrative referring to Table S1
regions.finding: Main-text-only optimization facts were retained for 4CzIPN, the best Ir result, 1 equiv 2a, 0.03 M, three named additives, light/photocatalyst controls, 1 mmol/0.05 M, and 427 nm. Missing numerical SI rows were not reconstructed.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 reaction header and standard conditions
regions.finding: Shared 1.0 mmol allenoic acid/sulfonyl chloride, 1.0 mmol TsOH·H2O, 0.01 mmol Ir catalyst, DCM 20 mL, 427 nm/40 W, N2, room temperature, and 4–6 cm distance were applied only to their own Table 1 rows.
Fifteen independent allenoic-acid entries 3aa–3oa were retained with row time/temperature/yield, printed selectivity where present, and footnoted cycloisomerization products 5h/5i/5k/5l/5o.
Twelve independent sulfonyl-chloride entries 3ab–3al were retained, including distinct 3le (1l+2e), printed ratios, and footnoted 5l/5a outcomes.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 air-control footnote and X-ray statements
regions.finding: The air 0.1 mmol control is separate (3aa not observed; 7% 1a recovery by NMR). CCDC 2321629 characterizes 3aa; the main-text esterification of (Z)-4le to X-ray product (Z)-10le/CCDC 2127599 is retained as a highly partial experiment without importing page S35.

unresolved: Desired-product yield basis is not stated generally in Table 1.
Several miniature substituted structures remain label/name candidates with null SMILES.
Table S1 is not associated; its omitted row values and complete conditions remain missing.

regions.region: page 3 continuation of Table 1 scope discussion
regions.finding: Narrative yields and side products were reconciled with the 27 Table 1 rows; three separate failed sulfonyl chlorides 2m/2n/2o were retained under standard conditions without importing cited SI pages S42–S44.
A distinct 8.0 mmol 1a scale-up under standard conditions for 62 h gives 3aa 1.5599 g/57% with 3aa/(Z)-4aa = 91/9.
Three independent transformations give 6 (54%), 7 (69%), and 8 (82%). LiDA/Ac2O and NaHMDS/ClP(O)(OPh)2 were each represented as two ordered −78 °C stages with their separate 0.5 h and 4 h holds.
The radical trap, (Z)-4aa conversion, CV, Stern–Volmer, and proposed mechanism continue into the actual figures on page 4 and are linked cross-page rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Failed 2m/2n/2o experiments omit time, recovery, byproducts, and detection limits in the main article.
Scheme 3 omits scale and yield basis for the three derivatizations.

regions.finding: The 0.1 mmol 1a/2a experiment with 2 equiv 1,1-diphenylethylene under standard conditions for 16 h gives 3aa ND, (Z)-4aa ND, trap product 9 61%, and 77% recovery of 1a.
A separate 0.12 mmol (Z)-4aa experiment under standard conditions for 16 h gives 3aa in 19% NMR yield and 58% recovery of (Z)-4aa.

Reduction potentials printed in the text were associated with 1a, 2a, 1m, 2l, 2k and the excited Ir photocatalyst; the figure's −2 V to +2 V scan direction was retained. Missing electrode/electrolyte/scan-rate details remain unresolved.
Visible regression equations and the comparative quenching interpretation were retained without merging the two panel-specific 2a fits. Unprinted measurement settings remain missing.

anti/syn Int I and Int II were classified as proposed intermediates, not isolated preparations. The slow conversion of (Z)-4aa to 3aa is represented as mechanism context and separately supported by Scheme 4b.
